title: Crossing Over Visualization
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: college placement Biology
description: Step-through visualization of crossing over during prophase I showing how allele segments are exchanged between homologous chromosomes to produce recombinant chromatids

learningObjectives: Explain how crossing over during prophase I generates recombinant chromatids
Predict which alleles will appear on recombinant chromatids after crossing over
Distinguish parental from recombinant chromatid types
Compare single vs double crossover outcomes

keyQuestions: Which alleles will each recombinant chromatid carry after crossing over?
How does crossing over increase genetic diversity?
What effect does double crossover have on recombination frequency?
commonMisconceptions: Crossing over exchanges entire chromosomes rather than segments
All four chromatids in a tetrad are recombinant after crossing over
Crossing over always occurs at the same location
assessmentOpportunities: Predict recombinant allele combinations before reveal
Compare single vs double crossover results
